response.justification: The candidate is technically excellent and exceeds every skill requirement — strong TypeScript/Node.js, React, AWS, Kubernetes, and even AI-agent/MCP experience matching the nice-to-haves. However, with nearly 20 years of experience and Staff/Senior titles, he is significantly overqualified for an entry-level position, raising serious concerns about compensation fit, engagement, and retention. Additionally, he is currently employed full-time at re:cinq, which warrants clarification before proceeding.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js fullstack expertise plus React and REST API experience
Covers nice-to-haves: AI/LLM agent tooling (MCP), AWS services, Kubernetes
Strong engineering culture fit: TDD, clean architecture, mentoring, and knowledge sharing
concerns: Heavily overqualified for a junior/mid-level entry role — salary and retention risk
Database experience skews toward MongoDB; PostgreSQL not explicitly demonstrated
Currently employed as Staff Engineer; motivation for a step down is unclear

key_factors.factor: Complete technical skill match incl. nice-to-haves
